definition: a payment you make to use something
description: A young woman in a coral jacket rides a stand-up electric scooter along a sunlit seaside promenade, grinning at the camera with the blue sea and a stone breakwater behind her. She then stands beside a long rank of parked rental e-scooters at the water's edge, tapping her phone; a close-up over her shoulder shows the rental app open on the screen with a circular logo and a blue button. Finally a wide shot shows a palm-lined promenade with a dozen people riding hired e-scooters past the trees.
